Template for the delimited block written into `AGENTS.md` and `CLAUDE.md` (SKILL.md Step 11).

Replace **only** the content between the markers. Never touch a byte outside them. Re-running with
unchanged inputs must produce an unchanged block.

If the file exists without markers, append the block after a `---` rule. If the file does not
exist, create it with a `# <FILE> — <repo-name>` title followed by the block.

---

```markdown
<!-- SIGN:BEGIN — generated by sign-encode-repo. Edits inside this block are overwritten on regeneration. -->

## Repo canon (SIGN) — orient from this first

This repo publishes a compiled SIGN engineering canon. **Read the index below, then fetch only the
one document you need** from `.agent/sign/dist/codebase.<slug>.bundle.sign`. Do not re-read the
codebase to orient — the canon is the map.

```text
@canon v1.0
@doc <PREFIX>-OVERVIEW  [ref, active]  ## <summary line>
@doc <PREFIX>-ARCH      [std, active]  ## <summary line>
@doc <PREFIX>-DEPS      [ref, active]  ## <summary line>
@doc <PREFIX>-STANDARDS [std, active]  ## <summary line>
```

**Provenance.** Every document above is `machine-drafted`: generated by reading the code, and **not
yet ratified by a human**. Coverage is <T>% under governance, <A>% human-ratified. Treat the canon
as a well-informed starting map, not as authority. Where it conflicts with the code, the code wins
— and the canon is then wrong and should be corrected.

**Layout.**
- `.agent/sign/src/` — authored documents (the source of truth; edit here)
- `.agent/sign/dist/` — compiled index, bundle, manifest, coverage (generated; never hand-edit)

**Keeping it true.** When the public surface changes — routes, contracts, build manifests, config
catalogs, exported interfaces — update the canon in the same change. A stale canon is worse than no
canon, because agents trust it.

<!-- SIGN:END -->
```

---

## Substitutions

| Placeholder | Source |
|---|---|
| `<slug>` | `canon.source.json` → `slug` |
| `<PREFIX>` | `canon.source.json` → `docPrefix` |
| `<summary line>` | each document's `##` line, verbatim from `src/` |
| `<T>` / `<A>` | `coverage.json` → `coveragePct.total` / `coveragePct.asserted` |

## Notes

- Keep the `@doc` lines column-aligned; it costs nothing and makes the index scannable.
- Do **not** paste the full Layer 1 index here — the compact four-line form is the point. The real
  index with `@links` and `@anchor` lives in `dist/`.
- The provenance paragraph is not boilerplate to trim. It is the sentence that stops a reader from
  mistaking generated content for ratified content.
